protocol.design: For each subject, blinded pairwise comparison of the remediated COMPLETE book vs its rejected base assembly (v1), using the frozen loop/judges/pairwise.md instrument, in AB and BA label orders. Judges receive only A/B texts plus reader_goal/audience; no run identities, hashes, or history.
protocol.judge_family: openai (gpt-5.6-sol via codex-role adapter), independent of the meta generator family
protocol.order_control: Both AB and BA label orders judged independently; order-effect analysis compares winners across orders.
protocol.grounding: Every quoted passage verified by code against the labeled book text it is attributed to.
protocol.scope: Exploratory learning judgment for Iteration 2. Non-promotional: no calibration, no promotion, no efficacy claims.

argument.a_quote: What uncertainty blocks is prescription — nobody may tell you, from this evidence, that you must eliminate everything or that a program is mandatory. What it does not block is your own reported difficulty, which needs no review's permission to be real.
argument.b_quote: What uncertainty blocks is prescription — nobody may tell you, from this evidence, that you must eliminate everything or that a program is mandatory. What it does not block is your own reported difficulty, which needs no review's permission to be real.
argument.reason: Both books make the same carefully bounded argument, distinguish uncertainty from dismissal, address strong objections explicitly, and preserve the reader's agency without turning anecdotes or unsettled science into prescriptions.

recognition.a_quote: If your weeks looked like this, you have company — and one caution travels with it: severe or persistent physical symptoms, depression, or significant distress should be professionally assessed rather than assumed to be sugar withdrawal. If they did not, nothing is wrong with you.
recognition.b_quote: If your weeks looked like this, you have company — and one caution travels with it: severe or persistent physical symptoms, depression, or significant distress should be professionally assessed rather than assumed to be sugar withdrawal. If they did not, nothing is wrong with you.
recognition.reason: Both books recognize difficult and divergent experiences without shaming the reader, diagnosing them, or presenting one person's course as the norm.

progression.a_quote: So what can you actually do, if nothing here is a prescription? That is the next and last chapter's question: observations you can note down, and lines you do not cross alone.
progression.b_quote: So what can you actually do, if nothing here is a prescription? That is the next and last chapter's question: observations you can note down, and lines you do not cross alone.
progression.reason: The chapter sequence is otherwise identical and cumulative, but A follows this transition with the accurately aligned title “Observations you can note, lines you do not cross alone.” B instead labels the chapter “Experiments you can observe” while immediately disclaiming that the prompts are experiments, creating a small conceptual discontinuity.

voice.a_quote: It has — abdicated the throne it never owned. No presidency over your pantry was ever on offer from this evidence
voice.b_quote: It has — abdicated the throne it never owned. No presidency over your pantry was ever on offer from this evidence
voice.reason: Both use the same direct, memorable, and natural voice, balancing rhetorical energy with disciplined qualifications. B's isolated capitalization error does not materially alter the voice.

emotional_movement.a_quote: You came in believing you had no say — white-knuckle abstinence or failure. The evidence does not grant you control it cannot measure. It returns something adjacent: questions worth asking, observations worth noting down, lines worth not crossing alone, and the knowledge that a lapse is information, not a verdict.
emotional_movement.b_quote: You came in believing you had no say — white-knuckle abstinence or failure. The evidence does not grant you control it cannot measure. It returns something adjacent: questions worth asking, observations worth noting down, lines worth not crossing alone, and the knowledge that a lapse is information, not a verdict.
emotional_movement.reason: Both achieve the same credible movement from shame and fatalism toward bounded agency, while avoiding promises, pressure, or false reassurance.

economy.b_quote: ## 6. Experiments you can observe, lines you do not cross alone
economy.reason: The books are otherwise essentially identical in length and development. A's title states the chapter's limited function precisely; B's word “Experiments” requires the opening paragraph to negate that framing, introducing a small but avoidable inefficiency.

recognition.b_quote: failed attempts across months and years are a real, reported pattern, not evidence of a defective character.
recognition.reason: Both recognize repeated attempts, lapses, and distress without shaming the reader or converting anecdotal experiences into diagnoses.

economy.a_quote: Its questions are optional prompts for describing your concerns and preparing a professional conversation — not a validated method, experiment, or instrument, and not a way to establish personal patterns
economy.b_quote: Its questions are optional prompts for describing your concerns and preparing a professional conversation — not a validated method, experiment, or instrument, and not a way to establish personal patterns

argument.b_quote: No method works for everyone; relapse can occur and is information, not a verdict.
argument.reason: B preserves the useful distinction between relapse and personal failure without asserting an unsupported prevalence claim. A says relapse is common despite expressly stating that the book cannot establish how common any trajectory is.

recognition.a_quote: Second, write down what prior attempts gave you and what they cost — benefits and problems in your own words, without grading yourself.

Because this appears in the safety information, readers may reasonably treat it as an evidence-backed fact.

order_effects.sugar: Remediated wins progression+economy in BOTH orders; voice flips to remediated only in BA (weak, single-order). No pro-base win in either order.
order_effects.smoking: Remediated wins argument in BOTH orders; emotional_movement flips to remediated only in BA (weak). The same OVERCLAIM critical ('relapse is common') tracks the BASE book in both orders. No pro-base win in either order.

analysis.variance: Low: decisive dimensions replicate across orders; only minor single-order flips (voice/emotional_movement).
analysis.grounding: 50/50 quoted passages resolve by code against the attributed labeled texts.
residual_weaknesses: Both books lean heavily on repeated caveat restatement (economy ties note repetitiveness).
Wrapper prose (front matter, headers, transitions) was the defect locus in both audits, not evidence-bound bodies.
analysis.conclusion: Remediation strictly improved both books with no observed regressions. Both Iteration-1 books stand as complete.

learning_decision.rule: Exactly one generalizable intervention for Iteration 2.
learning_decision.decision: Extend evidence-mapping discipline to ALL generated wrapper prose (brief-derived front matter, plan-derived chapter headers, chapter opening/closing transitions): every empirical-sounding sentence outside claim-mapped body prose must either carry an explicit evidence citation resolvable in the dossier or be rephrased to non-empirical language before assembly.
learning_decision.evidence: Both final audits' material findings concentrated in wrappers (front-matter prevalence claim; header experiment-status; transition universals), never in evidence-bound chapter bodies. Both remediation rounds repaired wrappers only.
learning_decision.implementation: Deterministic advisory wrapper screen (screen_wrappers) appended to assembly screening so the final auditor must triage wrapper flags; performer discipline in Iteration-2 drafting.
learning_decision.scope: Applies to both Iteration-2 subjects and all future runs. Non-promotional study; no efficacy claim.
